continuity: Row9 near-down-right joins frontal 180 down, then turns toward left and rises through upper left to near-up. 337.5 returns naturally to frontal 000 up. Cardinals remain correct; no explicit quadrant reversal. Some neighboring intermediate poses are visually similar, so the loop is semantically continuous but not a precise evenly spaced angular sweep.
integrity: Consistent identity, complete hair/body silhouettes, stable skirt/knees/socks/shoes and feet baseline. No conspicuous crop, sudden scale change or character redesign in row10.
limitations: Preclean color fringes deliberately excluded. Alpha edges and any cleanup damage require final light/dark background verification.
